faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chikkaballapur District CHO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Community Health Officer (CHO) position in Chikkaballapur District is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the CHO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) degree to be eligible for the Community Health Officer (CHO) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Community Health Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Community Health Officer (CHO) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 40,000 per month, plus performance-linked incentives.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the CHO post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Community Health Officer (CHO) position in the Chikkaballapur District recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Chikkaballapur District Community Health Officer (CHO) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the CHO position?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a merit system, considering 70% for merit, 20% for experience, and 10% for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the contract period for the CHO post?
faq.answer: The contract for the Community Health Officer (CHO) position is initially until 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Chikkaballapur District, which is https://chikkaballapur.nic.in.
